description: Alex has been tracking sleep quality experiments for 2 weeks. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sleep_experiment_raw.txt to see the raw data. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sleep_analysis_complete.xlsx with two sheets: (1) 'Raw_Data' - structure the 14 nights of data with columns for Night#, Date, Strategy A/B/C/D Used (Yes/No), Sleep Quality (1-10), Times Woken; (2) 'Analysis' - calculate average sleep quality and times woken for each strategy using formulas, identify the best strategy. Apply conditional formatting: green for sleep quality ≥8, red for ≤5. Bold all headers. Highlight the best strategy cell in yellow. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
